FN-9KVIBP-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 427
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Representative Juandalynn Givan
Analyst: JT Mathis Date: 05/08/2023
House Bill 427 as introduced could increase the obligations of state agencies required to
provide services on state holidays by a minimal, undetermined amount to provide compensatory
leave or paid compensation in lieu of the state holiday to employees working on the state
holiday dependent upon the compensation of the employees.
